keyLimits.en: 1 website, 1 domain, 20 GB bandwidth (~20k visitors/month), 100 marketing subscribers, 1,200 emails/month, 1 community (100 members), 5 videos up to 10 min each, 2 admin seats.
1 website, 5 funnels, 6 domain connections, 60 GB bandwidth, 100 marketing subscribers, 1,200 emails/month, 1 community (100 members), 5 videos up to 10 min each.
1 website, 10 funnels, 11 domain connections, 100 GB bandwidth, 1,000 marketing subscribers, 12,000 emails/month, full e-commerce with 100 products, A/B testing, upsells/downsells.
5 websites, unlimited funnels/domains, 200 GB bandwidth, 2,500 marketing subscribers, 30,000 emails/month, unlimited products and full e-commerce features.

addOns.en: Email/marketing subscriber add-ons scale from 500 to 500,000 subscribers, ranging roughly $9 to $1,499/month.

cautions.en: Separate White Label plans ($69-$497/month) exist for agencies reselling Simvoly under their own brand; not recorded as the main plans as they target agencies, not end users.

capabilities.en: Drag-and-drop website builder with e-commerce (product catalog, upsells/downsells, A/B testing on higher plans).
Sales funnel builder integrated with the website builder, plus email marketing and video hosting.
Community/membership feature (member-gated content) bundled into every plan.

limitations.en: No free plan; entry Starter plan starts at $18/month (or $12/month annual) with tight bandwidth and email caps.
E-commerce features (A/B testing, upsells/downsells) are gated behind the Premium plan and above, unavailable on Starter/Business.
